fixes.explanation: Miriam it is. The text says it plainly: "There Miriam died and was buried." She's Moses and Aaron's sister (Numbers 26:59), and the text gives her passing just one short sentence. I think that's a heavy way to begin this stretch of the story.

Midian isn't the place they name, friend. The people say, "Why have you led us up out of Egypt to bring us to this wretched place?" Egypt is the place they name. They're complaining about where they are now, and Midian never comes up in this scene.

Strikes. "…Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff…" And here's the catch. The LORD had told Moses and Aaron to speak to the rock (Numbers 20:8). Speak, not strike. The water still gushed out, but Moses did something different from what he was told, and the scene isn't done yet.
